provider: CUHK Department of Sociology 2025-26 Major Study Scheme and current Course Listing
academicYear: 2025-26 intake / current course listing reviewed on 2026-07-28
note: The official 2025-26 Sociology Major Study Scheme requires a minimum of 69 units: a 9-unit Faculty Package containing SOCI1001 and two courses from different Social Science departments or schools, 27 units from nine named Required courses, and 33 units from the published Sociology elective pool, including at least 6 units at 3000 level or above. The same official DOCX publishes a Course List assigning 3 units to every included SOCI course, while the current Department Course Listing supplies the live English titles for all 10 fixed SOCI courses and all 52 SOCI electives named by the Study Scheme. The live page has expanded or updated titles for SOCI2219, SOCI3225, SOCI3451-3453 and SOCI4202, and uses an ampersand in SOCI3208; this supplement uses those current live titles while retaining the 2025-26 Study Scheme membership and units. SOCI1102 appears in the general Course List but not in the 2025-26 Major elective pool and is therefore excluded. Optional Concentrations contain cross-department pools, theme-dependent Capstone, Internship, Field Studies and Directed Studies counting, senior-entry requirements, and supervisor endorsement rules that the local rule engine cannot prove. This 62-course list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
